limitations: Retrospective evidence access; not a prospective forecast test
Random question folds do not separate event families or time
Both archived-confidence readings are conditional interpretations
One generation per question and condition; no run-variability estimate

settings.cohort: intersection of valid questions across nine variants per model
settings.deployment_cost: selection requires nine saved training forecasts per question; ensemble requires nine inference responses per new question, baseline/selected each require one
settings.ensemble: equal probability mean of all nine variants
settings.selection: lowest training-question Brier; variant-name tie break
settings.uncertainty: descriptive point estimates; no significance tests or intervals
